{{legend|#D3D3D3|No election}}
]]
Eleven senators—four Democrats and seven Republicans—announced they would not seek reelection. This is the most in a single election cycle since [[1996 United States Senate elections|1996]], when thirteen senators chose not to run again.{{efn|In the [[2010 United States Senate elections|2010 Senate elections]], the [[2010 United States Senate special election in Massachusetts|Massachusetts special election]] was not included in the list and not part in the regular election cycle.}}<ref>{{Cite web |title=House retirements tied for most this century |url=https://www.axios.com/2026/03/02/members-of-congress-retirements-record-high |access-date=March 9, 2026 |website=Axios |date=March 2, 2026 }}</ref>
